name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a **3px solid focus ring, outset 1px**, with a **4.5:1 contrast ratio**. This delivers the clearest visual cue for keyboard users while keeping the ring large enough to spot on high-density screens. The trade-off is slightly more layout shift on focus, but the benefit to sighted keyboard navigators outweighs the minor disruption.

name: Reader
text: A 3px outset ring risks pushing interactive elements into adjacent content, creating overlap on small screens or dense layouts. A 2px inset ring with 4.5:1 contrast avoids this but may fade on high-DPI screens. Test both on a 320px mobile viewport with 125% zoom—if either causes overlap or vanishing, pick the other.
